name: GenAi_Skills — Design resource library
generated: Automatically from each folder's README.md/LIBRARY.md — do not edit by hand.

resources.name: Design Critique
resources.summary: Skill that gives structured feedback on a design — first impression, usability, visual hierarchy, consistency and accessibility — with severity ratings and prioritised fixes.
resources.platform: Claude (skill or slash command); the framework works as agent instructions on any platform
resources.how_to_use: Install this folder as a skill, then share a Figma link, screenshot or description with its context and stage (exploration, refinement, final) and ask for a critique.

resources.name: Design Library Finder
resources.summary: Skill (for Claude) and universal prompt (for ChatGPT and other agents) that searches this repository's catalogue by area, work phase and topic and returns the resources to use, with links and how to apply them.
resources.platform: Claude (SKILL.md); ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and enterprise agents (PROMPT.md)
resources.how_to_use: On Claude install this folder as a skill; on any other agent paste the prompt in PROMPT.md into its instructions. Then ask e.g. "find UX material for usability testing".

resources.name: Find Skills (Vercel skills CLI)
resources.summary: Skill that helps an AI agent discover and install public agent skills from the open skills ecosystem, bundled with the source of Vercel's skills CLI.
resources.platform: Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…). The CLI needs Node.js; designers will mostly use the SKILL.md only.
resources.how_to_use: For designers, install skills/find-skills/SKILL.md as a skill. The rest of the folder is the CLI source code (MIT, © Vercel) and is for developers.

resources.name: Interface Design Checklists
resources.summary: Agent package with 1,084 review questions across 31 interface patterns, usable to design a component from scratch or to audit an existing design.
resources.platform: Agnostic — any enterprise AI platform (instructions + knowledge base + output templates)
resources.how_to_use: Load AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md as the agent's instructions, attach the files in knowledge-base/ as knowledge, and use templates-html-di-riferimento/ as the output structure. Read only the pattern files relevant to the task.
